request.auth: SigV4 using explicit S3 material, service logs and exact pool
request.mapping: typed request fields; absent optional fields omitted; values retained explicitly
request.period: explicit Start/End; logs after millisecond conversion; range step exact decimal seconds

response.numeric_precision: integer/decimal literals and sample strings retained without float64
response.completeness: bounded partial collection/prefix, never a successful full result on limit
response.provider_metadata: all mapped CloudWatch token/search metadata retained in ProviderPages

errors.sample_limit: response_limit, typed bounded prefix, complete false

retry: bounded safe reads; each retry receives new signature when applicable

pagination.Events: end only when nextForwardToken equals incoming token; empty pages continue
